jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We build scheduling tools for event organisers across Europe. You will design, build and run TypeScript services and React interfaces, integrate third-party APIs, and own features from idea to production. You have shipped production software, write tests by habit, and use AI coding tools with judgement. We offer a small team, real ownership and a calm pace.

Requirements

  • Experience with TypeScript and React
  • Comfortable with real-time sync
